question: Product clarification needed before implementing dependent pause behavior: Should pause (1) block only new scheduled Runs while manual Runs and in-flight Runs/retries/alerts continue unchanged, or also block any of those; (2) be a separate persisted flag from enabled, so resume preserves disabled status; and (3) appear as a new Paused dashboard column? I recommend scheduled-only, separate flag, and a Paused column while preserving existing Last result. Repeated pause/resume would be idempotent 200 responses.
answer: Manual Runs remain allowed while a Job is paused. Existing Runs continue to their normal terminal outcome, with the existing retry and alert behavior preserved. For the enabled/disabled setting and dashboard presentation, use the supplied evidence and ordinary reversible engineering judgment; the operator supplies no additional product preference on those items.

other_items.reason: Task already requires preserving existing behavior; inspect supplied enabled-state semantics.

scoring_note: Question about scheduled-only blocking repeats task requirement and asks manual/in-progress scope; it does not ask whether skipped scheduled work is queued or replayed. Idempotence is stated as an engineering choice, not a question.
